content.title: Why Zevia (ZVIA) Stock Is Trading Up Today
content.summary: Shares of beverage company Zevia (NYSE:ZVIA) jumped 6.6% in the morning session after Telsey Advisory Group issued a positive "Outperform" rating on the stock. This rating indicated that the advisory firm's analysts expected Zevia's stock to perform better than the overall market. Such a positive outlook from a financial firm often boosts investor confidence in a company's prospects. This can lead to increased buying activity from investors, which helped push the share price higher.
